![Photo by [Nadin Mario](https://unsplash.com/@nadinmario?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by Nadin Mario on Unsplash"}

warm, sweet, metallic red \
\* \
i desire \
the paleness of your skin \
\* \
pulse of your heart \
i want to resist \
your beauty just makes it too hard \
\* \
i do, i want to resist \
i can taste your fragrance from across the square \
your laughter engulfs me \
but not only me \
\* \
your summer dress \
attracts the crowds as you dance \
as you smile and sweat \
your fragrance grows stronger \
my control wanes \
\* \
yet i resist \
as the night dims \
and the crowds fade \
my mind races to the thought \
bloodless for days \
none that I enjoyed anyway \
\* \
you end your night \
violin packed away \
you cross the square \
heading my way \
i must decide \
\* \
raising my hand \
reaching out to you \
a dance I say \
last one — would you? \
\* \
A waltz it is \
your sweeter than I dreamt \
I caress your face \
\* \
you look at me \
with full permission \
\* \
I pause, and fly away

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

End notes: \
Even bloodsuckers fall in love beyond the flesh.

I love to read [https://medium.com/@ravynehawke](https://medium.com/@ravynehawke) and [https://medium.com/@wakinguprazzledazzle](https://medium.com/@wakinguprazzledazzle). They inspire me to keep writing and publishing on Medium.
